_note: Updated through D-032, local only and not deployed. DOCX body paragraphs and simple tables now feed existing local retrieval with body/table positions. Two synthetic Word documents cover 10 fixed questions; this is retrieval coverage, not generated answer accuracy. No new API or visible latency measurement. Earlier images keep their dated provenance; the DOCX image is a synthetic retrieval/citation UI state.

label.ja: 47の固定質問中36の目標範囲を取得（開発用データ含む）。回答正答率ではない。262テスト中261成功・1スキップ。
label.zh: 47个固定问题中的36个目标片段全部找到（含开发数据）；不是回答正确率。262项检查，261通过、1跳过。

verification.ja: D-030の4段TTSは非表示Canvas p95 2.753秒。可視3秒は未達。6問の回答段階チェックには資料欠落時の表現と簡単版の条件省略が残り、第三者試用は未実施。
verification.zh: D-030四段TTS的隐藏Canvas p95为2.753秒，可见3秒目标仍未通过。6题回答阶段检查仍有资料缺失表述和简易回复条件遗漏，尚无第三方试用。
verification.en: D-030 four-turn TTS hidden Canvas p95: 2.753 s; visible 3 s acceptance remains unmet. The six-question answer stage still has a missing-information wording failure and an omitted condition in a simple reply. No third-party trial yet.

change.ja: 2 文の録音だけで認識モデルを替え、後で 1 文まるごと捏造する失敗を見つけた。次は少数の結果で決めず、保存した実音声で再生して確かめてから変える。
change.zh: 只凭 2 句录音就换了识别模型，后来才发现它会把一整段话编成套话。下次不凭少量结果下结论，先用保存的真实录音重放确认再改。
change.en: I switched the recognition model on just two recorded sentences and only later found it could replace a whole sentence with a stock phrase. Next time: replay saved real audio before changing anything.
